author: acceptance_release
reason: All 17 exact owned ABI/select call sites were independently enumerated from Python ASTs and all 150 None/removal operator instances regenerated. Every replacement preserves the callee, ABI argument count, original syscall/prctl command word and pointer/size expressions. Replacements change distinct integer data/flags words or explicitly borrowed existing read descriptors and nonnegative timeouts. The original calls remain byte-identical. Four independent operator tests passed, including all eight select variants in a child with stdin deliberately closed. Duplicate programs remain rejected. Unknown call shapes fail generation. This approves only the exact typed generator family, not mutation outcomes, equivalent exceptions, runtime-error kills or broader operator exclusions.
